summary: Waive the AISDLC-1169 shadow-report precondition on AISDLC-1172 and cut over to the RFC-0061 verdict gate now

options.description: Drop the shadow-report precondition; AISDLC-1172 dispatchable after AISDLC-1193 lands
Keep the precondition until the shadow report shows no unexplained disagreement

body: The v6 attestation gate keeps blocking merges (2026-11-05: #2272 and #2331 failed on missing envelopes; the shadow review-verdict status blocks CLEAN). The shadow report has 5 verdict records, too few to compare, and v6 has no recorded true catch (RFC-0061 design review). Cutover proceeds after AISDLC-1192 (shadow status never blocks) and AISDLC-1193 (every pipeline push carries a verdict ref).
